abstract.t: This document defines YANG over BGP (YoBGP), an extension of BGP for distributing network configuration objects (for example routing policies, prefix sets, community sets, and access control lists) modeled in YANG. Objects are carried in a dedicated Address Family (AFI/SAFI) and spread between routers the way routes do: they are advertised to peers, carry a version, are filtered on receipt, and are optionally re-advertised. Received objects are subject to a per- peer inbound filtering framework, persist in the receiving node's configuration independently of the state of the BGP session, and are removed only by an explicit, versioned tombstone. Its goal is effortless synchronization of selected configuration settings across a large number of BGP speakers. The framework is schema-agnostic: any YANG module, including vendor-specific ones, can be distributed.
